title: Harry Styles receives Guinness World Record for longest Wembley Stadium run
facts: Harry Styles received a Guinness World Record for completing 12 sold-out concerts at Wembley Stadium.
Harry Styles broke the official record for the longest residency by a musician at Wembley Stadium in a single run.
The band Coldplay held the previous Wembley Stadium residency record with 10 nights in 2025.
Will Munford served as the official Guinness World Records adjudicator for Harry Styles' record.
Harry Styles started the London leg of his Together, Together tour on June 12, 2026.
Approximately 80,000 people attended the final show of Harry Styles' Wembley Stadium run.
The boyband One Direction formed in 2010 on the television talent show The X Factor.
The music group One Direction went on an indefinite hiatus in 2016.
Former One Direction bandmate Liam Payne died at the age of 31 in 2024.
Harry Styles officially launched his solo music career in 2017.
Harry Styles released his fourth studio album, titled 'Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally', in January 2026.
Harry Styles has received six Brit Awards and three Grammy Awards throughout his solo career.
Wembley Stadium unveiled a commemorative banner to mark Harry Styles' 12-show record.
Harry Styles performed exclusively in London for the United Kingdom leg of his current tour.
Taylor Swift previously played an eight-night residency at Wembley Stadium in 2024.
